---
title: "Baseball Through the Numbers"
---

Welcome to a data-driven look at Major League Baseball history using the Lahman database. Comparing home runs per team-game puts seasons of different lengths in context, while the career leaderboard is topped by Barry Bonds, Hank Aaron, and Babe Ruth.

Choose **Home runs** or **Sluggers** in the navbar to explore the season-by-season trends, career leaders, and Barry Bonds' yearly totals.
